title: We Need to Talk
overview: We Need to Talk - 3rd Stand-up comedy special from Aravind S.A is an entertaining and yet sensitive take on SA’s mental health journey. He goes into what makes an overthinking mind tick; spilling hilariously about his anxiety, his early years as an Assistant Director in Tamil Cinema, and most importantly, 12 years with his therapist.
